scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:waitlist
scripts.waitlist:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply WAITLIST_DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.waitlist:inspect:local: wrangler d1 execute WAITLIST_DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc --command "SELECT email, created_at, consented_at, consent_version, notified_at FROM launch_waitlist ORDER BY created_at"
scripts.waitlist:delete-smoke:local: wrangler d1 execute WAITLIST_DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc --command "DELETE FROM launch_waitlist WHERE email = 'local-smoke@planets.invalid'"
scripts.waitlist:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute WAITLIST_DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc --command "DELETE FROM launch_waitlist"
